scripts.build:all: npm run build:core-frontend && pnpm -r run build
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:core-backend" "npm run dev:core-frontend"
scripts.dev:core-backend: cd core/backend && PYTHONPATH=src python -m uvicorn --factory codegen_core.dashboard.api:create_app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n core,react -c yellow,green "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:react"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:core && npm run smoke:core-frontend && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:core: cd core/backend && PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q
scripts.lint:core: cd core/backend && python -m ruff check src tests
